title: New to One Stream Need some help on learning about one stream
author: lsrinivas2k13
content: Hi everyone, I am very much new to OneStream but i am not able to see any resources for learning about OneStream. Can someone guide my about finding the right sources for getting started and learn the basics of onestream
solution_text: Welcome to the OneStream community. I think your best bet is to jump in and check out the free content in Navigator @ https://onestream.thoughtindustries.com/learn/dashboard. There is a bunch of content in there that doesn't require a subscription from courses to videos. There is also the OneCommunity Blog which has some good beginner content. Lastly I guess I need to mention the documentation if you haven't been there already. https://documentation.onestream.com/
